text.description: Message delivered to this thread when the wake-up fires.

trigger.description: Structured QueueTrigger: { kind: 'at', time }, { kind: 'after_turn', thread, onlyOnSuccess? }, { kind: 'after_command', argv, cwd?, timeoutS? }, or { kind: 'poll_command', argv, cwd?, everyS, maxTries, timeoutS? }.

inMinutes.description: Shortcut for an 'at' trigger N minutes from now.

at.description: Shortcut for an 'at' trigger at an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp.

afterThread.description: Shortcut for an 'after_turn' trigger waiting for another thread's turn to end.

onlyOnSuccess.description: Used with afterThread: fire only if that turn ends done.

afterCommand.description: Shortcut for an 'after_command' trigger: program and arguments.

pollCommand.description: Shortcut for a 'poll_command' trigger: program and arguments polled until exit 0.

cwd.description: Optional workspace-relative working directory for afterCommand or pollCommand.

everyS.description: Poll interval in seconds for pollCommand (default 60).
